fuentes.titulo: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. Reports Results for Fiscal Second Quarter 2027
fuentes.texto: NEW YORK --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Nov. 9, 2026-- Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ:TTWO) today reported results for the second quarter of its fiscal year 2027, ended September 30, 2026 . For further information, please see the second quarter fiscal 2027 results slide deck posted to the Company’s investor relations website at take2games.com/ir . CEO Comments Strauss Zelnick , Chairman and CEO of Take-Two Interactive, stated: “The launch of Grand Theft Auto VI is ten days away and, with pre-orders continuing to reach unprecedented levels, we expect to deliver an historic year for our company. We are reiterating our outlook for Fiscal 2027 Net Bookings of $8 to $8.2 billion , and are confident in our ability to build on this incredible year as we release new hits, explore emerging business opportunities, expand our geographic footprint, and pursue accretive M&A – all of which will set us on a path to unlock greater earnings power and long-term shareholder value.” Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial and Operational Highlights Total Net Bookings* decreased 18% to $1.60 billion compared to $1.96 billion during last year’s fiscal second quarter. Net Bookings from recurrent consumer spending** decreased 9% and accounted for 81% of total Net Bookings. The largest contributors to Net Bookings were NBA® 2K, the Grand Theft Auto® series, Toon Blast™ , Match Factory!™ , Empires & Puzzles™, the Borderlands® franchise, Words With Friends™, the Red Dead Redemption® series , Color Block Jam™ , WWE® 2K , and Zynga Poker™. GAAP net revenue was $1.50 billion , compared to $1.77 billion in last year’s fiscal second quarter. Recurrent consumer spending** decreased 5% and accounted for 81% of total GAAP net revenue. The largest contributors to GAAP net revenue were NBA 2K, the Grand Theft Auto series , Toon Blast , Match Factory! , Empires & Puzzles, the Borderlands franchise, Words With Friends, Color Block Jam , WWE 2K, the Red Dead Redemption series , and Zynga Poker. GAAP net loss was $54.0 million , or $0.29 per share, as compared to $133.9 million , or $0.73 per share, for the comparable period last year. * Net Bookings is our operational metric and defined as the net amount of products and services sold digitally or sold-in physically during the period, and includes licensing fees, merchandise, in-game advertising, strategy guides and publisher incentives. ** Recurrent consumer spending is generated from ongoing consumer engagement and includes virtual currency, add-on content, in-game purchases and in-game advertising. fuentes.titulo: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 prepared remarks (PDF)
fuentes.texto: SAFE HARBOR – Nicole Shevins • Good Afternoon. Thank you for joining our conference call to discuss our results for the second quarter of Fiscal Year 2027, ended September 30, 2026. Today’s call will be led by Strauss Zelnick, Take-Two’s Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Karl Slatoff, our President, and Lainie Goldstein, our Chief Financial Officer. We will be available to answer your questions during the Q&A session following our prepared remarks. • Before we begin, I’d like to remind everyone that statements made during this call that are not historical facts are considered forward-looking statements under federal securities laws. These forward-looking statements are based on the beliefs of our management, as well as assumptions made by and information currently available to us. We have no obligation to update these forward-looking statements. Actual operating results may vary significantly from these forward-looking statements based on a variety of factors. These important factors are described in our filings with the SEC, including the Company's most recent Annual Report on Form 10-K and Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q, including the risks summarized in the section entitled "Risk Factors." I'd also like to note that, unless otherwise stated, all numbers we will be discussing today are GAAP and all comparisons are year-over-year. Additional details regarding our actual results and outlook are contained in our press release, including the items that our management uses internally to adjust our GAAP financial results in order to evaluate our operating performance. Our press release also contains a reconciliation of any Non-GAAP financial measure to the most comparable GAAP measure. In addition, we have posted to our website a slide deck that visually presents our results and financial outlook. Our press release and filings with the SEC may be obtained from our website at take2games.com. • And now, I’ll turn the call over to Strauss. Strauss Zelnick • Thanks, Nicole. Good afternoon and thank you for joining us today. • We delivered second quarter Net Bookings of $1.6 billion, which was slightly below our guidance range of $1.62 to $1.67 billion. While NBA 2K27 launched successfully and achieved the 2nd highest Net Bookings performance in the history of the series, it was below our forecast for the period. Our mobile business performed in line with our 1 plans, and the Grand Theft Auto series exceeded our forecast ahead of next week’s eagerly anticipated launch of Grand Theft Auto VI. • We are reiterating our Fiscal 2027 outlook for Net Bookings of $8 to $8.2 billion. Pre- orders for Grand Theft Auto VI are tracking far in excess of our initial expectations, and we know that the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough. Our outlook also includes the launches of new mobile and previously-announced sports titles, and growth in Recurrent Consumer Spending for NBA 2K27 during the second half of our fiscal year, driven by the largest slate of post-launch content in franchise history. • Turning to highlights from the period: • Grand Theft Auto V continued to expand its audience, and to date, the title has sold nearly 235 million units worldwide. The series grew a double digit percentage for both Recurrent Consumer Spending and average monthly members for GTA+, as players enjoyed the latest major update, The Kortz Center Heist, along with monthly events, new races and more. In September, Rockstar Games unveiled nopixel V - the next evolution of Grand Theft Auto V's roleplay community, with an entirely overhauled experience, new locations, and graphic enhancements focused on player immersion. To celebrate the launch throughout the month, players were able to earn exclusive items within Grand Theft Auto Online by watching select roleplay streamers on Twitch. Rockstar Games will continue to support Grand Theft Auto Online with new content and ongoing events for its vast community. • Grand Theft Auto VI, coming to the world on November 19th, promises to be not only highly engaging, but in fact the biggest and most detailed, groundbreaking experience that Rockstar Games has ever created. As you have undoubtedly seen, marketing for the title is well underway across the globe and has included an extended look at the game, which premiered on Netflix and became the platform’s most-viewed title for the week, drawing in 31 million consumers in just its first four days; an array of in-depth features and magazine covers; the reveal of the official soundtrack, which included three tracks that debuted in the Top-10 of their respective Billboard charts; the announcement of a special “Night In Vice City” in partnership with the NBA where the Miami Heat will play as Vice City vs. the Milwaukee Bucks; and a series of unique, in- person activations celebrating Vice City in Miami. We are immensely proud of the team at Rockstar Games for their unparalleled commitment to, and passion for, elevating our art form and all entertainment. • 2K and Visual Concepts once again delivered the most realistic and authentic NBA experience in interactive entertainment with NBA 2K27, which has sold over 4 million units so far. The launch window was unusually busy, with numerous entertainment experiences competing for players’ attention. We expect an acceleration of Net Bookings and engagement during the second half of the year, as 2K and Visual Concepts plan to introduce a robust slate of in-game content including exciting, themed Seasons; all-new College Basketball experiences; and innovation within MyTeam. 2 • During the quarter, Borderlands 4 offered new downloadable content and introduced several promotions, which are driving improved engagement and player retention. The Borderlands franchise has now surpassed 100 million units sold, marking an incredible milestone for Gearbox and 2K. We look forward to even more content for Borderlands 4 and what lies ahead for the series. • During the period, 2K released add-on content and updates for Mafia: The Old Country, Sid Meier’s Civilization VII, PGA TOUR 2K, and WWE 2K, which enhanced gameplay and player engagement further for these titles. • Mobile performed in line with our expectations, underscoring the importance and impact of our diversified business. o As we had anticipated, Net Bookings for Color Block Jam decreased double-digits compared to its peak performance during last year’s second quarter. o Net Bookings for Toon Blast grew 4% over last year’s record second quarter results, driven by a new in-game feature called BEAM, which assists players while solving puzzles and has been increasing engagement and level progression. o Words With Friends benefitted from a multi-platform collaboration with the hit TV show, Wheel of Fortune, including a dedicated on-air theme week and in-game puzzles and online events for players, which drove Net Bookings growth of 6%. o Our advertising business improved sequentially, as we successfully attract new partners and increase ad yields. o 2K’s mobile offerings also continued to perform well, with solid downloads and engagement across key titles. NBA 2K All-Star, our mobile title in partnership with Tencent in China, surpassed 11 million registered users since launching last year and is yielding strong profit margins. o We continue to see strength in our mobile direct-to-consumer channel, which remains a significant driver of revenue and margins as we include new titles, foster direct relationships with players, and reduce payment friction to enhance the user experience and drive repeat purchases. These efforts position our direct-to- consumer platform as a durable and expanding engine for Net Bookings growth and long-term profitability. o Looking ahead, Zynga continues to develop and test many new titles, and several look promising based on their initial performance in soft launch, including Top Goal. • We believe that Fiscal 2027 will be an historic year for Take-Two – driven by our unwavering commitment to delivering the highest quality entertainment experiences. Guided by our core pillars – creativity, innovation, and efficiency – we are confident in our ability to build on this incredible year, and to set new benchmarks as we deliver on our plan for long-term success. • I’d like to express my gratitude to our 13,000 colleagues around the world for their dedication to our common mission and for making our company what it is today – and what we will be tomorrow. 3 • I’ll now turn the call over to Karl. Karl Slatoff • Thanks, Strauss. • I'd like to thank our teams, who do their best work every day in the pursuit of our creative, financial, and operational goals. • I’ll now discuss our recent and upcoming releases: ● On October 8th, 2K and Gearbox released Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts, which introduced two new playable survivors, new regions to explore, and expanded gameplay mechanics to deepen the player experience. ● 2K continued to innovate its mobile offerings for the NBA 2K franchise. On October 20th, NBA 2K Mobile Season 9 launched with new modes that connect in-game action to real-world NBA schedules; a rewind feature that allows players to enjoy historic and iconic NBA moments; and real-time Player vs. Player matches. Additionally, NBA 2K27 Arcade Edition made its debut last week, offering WNBA Play Now; new expansion teams; deeper career journeys and progressions; a new 5v5 experience; and exclusive G.O.A.T. skills and rewards. • On October 28th, 2K and Visual Concepts continued their post-launch content for WWE 2K26 with the release of Ringside Pass Season 6 and the standalone Street Fighter Elite Pack, which marks our first-ever collaboration with Capcom, and includes signature character moves and themed cosmetic creation parts. 2K also released Season 13 for WWE SuperCard last week, which has now been downloaded nearly 40 million times since its initial launch. ● Firaxis announced new content for Sid Meier's Civilization VII for 2027, including Arc of Tomorrow, a comprehensive free update extending gameplay into the Atomic Age, and Earthrise – the title’s first major premium expansion featuring extended core mechanics and space-era progression. These additions will provide players with more ways to "take one more turn" in this iconic strategy series. ● In the coming months, 2K will provide updates on PGA TOUR 2K27 and WWE 2K27, both of which are slated to launch later this fiscal year. • Zynga will continue to focus on enhancing its existing mobile portfolio with bold beats and updates, as well as releasing new titles, including Top Goal, which is currently in soft launch. 4 • It’s incredibly exciting to be just days away from Rockstar Games’ launch of Grand Theft Auto VI and pre-loads are rolling out across the world. This is a defining moment for our company and the entertainment industry, and our teams are proudly supporting this global phenomenon. • With our robust and diverse long-term product development pipeline, we are well- positioned to capitalize on our many opportunities on the horizon to engage audiences throughout the world. • I’ll now turn the call over to Lainie. Lainie Goldstein • Thanks Karl and good afternoon everyone. • Our second quarter Net Bookings were $1.6 billion, which was modestly below our guidance range of $1.62 to $1.67 billion. o Recurrent Consumer Spending was down 9% for the period, compared to our guidance of a 5% decline, driven by NBA 2K, and accounted for 81% of Net Bookings. Compared to last year, NBA 2K and mobile each decreased, while the Grand Theft Auto series was up. • GAAP net revenue decreased 16% to $1.5 billion, cost of revenue decreased 20% to $637 million, and operating expenses decreased 9% to $978 million. • On a management basis, operating expenses declined 9% year-over-year. This was favorable to our forecast, due to lower personnel and user acquisition costs. • Turning to our outlook: We are exceedingly optimistic about the rest of the year and are reiterating our fiscal 2027 Net Bookings outlook range of $8 to $8.2 billion. The launch of Grand Theft Auto VI is only ten days away, and the level of pre-orders generated is extraordinary. Additionally, 2K and Visual Concepts plan to deliver the most innovative array of in-game content ever released for NBA 2K, which gives us confidence that Recurrent Consumer Spending for the franchise will accelerate during the second half of the year. o The largest contributors to Net Bookings are expected to be the Grand Theft Auto series, NBA 2K, Toon Blast, Match Factory, Empires & Puzzles, Words with Friends, the Red Dead Redemption series, Color Block Jam, WWE 2K and Zynga Poker. o We continue to expect Recurrent Consumer Spending to be in-line with Fiscal 2026, representing 65% of Net Bookings. This assumes strong growth for the Grand Theft Auto series, largely due to our outlook for robust sales of Grand Theft Auto VI: Ultimate Edition, which includes add-on content; and high-single digit growth for NBA 2K. We continue to expect a decline in mobile, due to last year’s success of 5 Color Block Jam, and our assumption that trends will moderate for several of Zynga’s mature mobile titles. o We project the Net Bookings breakdown from our labels to be roughly 37% Rockstar Games, 34% Zynga, and 29% 2K. • We remain on track to deliver Operating Cash Flow in excess of $1 billion, and to be in a Net Cash position by the end of the fiscal year. Our expectation to deploy approximately $290 million of capital expenditures is unchanged. • We expect GAAP net revenue to range from $7.98 to $8.18 billion, cost of revenue to range from $3.68 to $3.8 billion, and operating expenses to range from $4.08 to $4.1 billion. • On a management basis, we now expect operating expense growth of approximately 5% year-over-year, which is favorable to our prior forecast, due to lower user acquisition costs, part of which is related to timing. The expense growth compared to last year is primarily driven by marketing for Grand Theft Auto VI and higher R&D costs. • Now, moving onto our guidance for the fiscal third quarter: • We project Net Bookings to range from $3.35 to $3.5 billion, compared to $1.76 billion in the prior year. o The largest contributors to Net Bookings are expected to be the Grand Theft Auto series, NBA 2K, Toon Blast, Match Factory, Empires & Puzzles, Words with Friends, the Red Dead Redemption series, Color Block Jam, Zynga Poker, and Toy Blast. o We project Recurrent Consumer Spending to increase by approximately 12%, which assumes significant growth for the Grand Theft Auto series, driven by sales of Grand Theft Auto VI: Ultimate Edition; growth for NBA 2K; and a decline in mobile. • We expect GAAP net revenue to range from $3.27 to $3.42 billion, cost of revenue to range from $1.65 to $1.73 billion, and operating expenses to range from $1.16 to $1.18 billion. • On a management basis, operating expenses are expected to grow by approximately 21% year-over-year, which is primarily driven by marketing costs to support the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI. • In closing, we are extremely optimistic about our path ahead, and next week’s launch of Grand Theft Auto VI is just the beginning. We believe that we can take our core franchises to the next level of success by releasing engaging new content and enhancing our live-service offerings, all while launching new hit titles, expanding our geographic footprint, and pursuing accretive M&A. As we execute this extensive, multi- 6 faceted strategy to drive growth, we feel confident in our ability to unlock greater earnings power and deliver long-term shareholder value. • I’d like to thank our talented, passionate colleagues around the world for their hard work and for getting us to this pivotal moment in our multi-year growth story. I’ll now turn the call back to Strauss. # # # 7

fuentes.titulo: Confirmed: Grand Theft Auto 5 breaks 6 sales world records
fuentes.texto: By Kevin Lynch Published 08 October 2013 --> Share Facebook Twitter Email Whatsapp Pinterest LinkedIn Reddit Contact an Account Manager Guinness World Records can today confirm that the launch of Grand Theft Auto V has broken six new world records including the Highest revenue generated by an entertainment product in 24 hours and the Fastest entertainment property to gross $1 billion. Released on 17 September 2013 for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 consoles, the fifteenth title in the Grand Theft Auto series, GTA V, was the first main entry since Grand Theft Auto IV in 2008. Developed by Rockstar North and published by Rockstar Games, the critically acclaimed open world action-adventure video game sold 11.21 million units in its first 24 hours, and generated revenue of $815.7 million (£511.8 million), going on to reach $1 billion (£624.45 million) in sales after just three days on September 20 2013. The figure smashes records previously held by the Call of Duty videogame series and blockbuster movies including The Avengers and Avatar. Guinness World Records Editor-in-Chief, Craig Glenday, said: "GTA totally deserves to be recognized as an icon of modern British culture, and we're thrilled to be able to feature the game in the record books. Gaming is no longer a niche hobby, as GTA 5 has proved, and how exciting that it's taken on the might of Hollywood and won! I'm also doubly proud as a Dundonian to welcome this home-grown series back into the Guinness World Records book.” Full list of Grand Theft Auto V record-breaking achievements: 1. Best-selling action-adventure videogame in 24 hours 2. Best-selling videogame in 24 hours 3. Fastest entertainment property to gross $1 billion 4. Fastest videogame to gross $1 billion 5. Highest grossing videogame in 24 hours 6. Highest revenue generated by an entertainment product in 24 hours 7. fuentes.titulo: Will GTA VI break the 24-hour sales record?
fuentes.texto: Will GTA VI break the 24-hour sales record? "Grand Theft Auto VI" is scheduled to release November 19, 2026.  This market will resolve to "Yes" if the officially announced sales revenue for "Grand Theft Auto VI" in the first 24 hours following its release exceeds $815.7 million, the current Guinness World Records-recognized highest-grossing videogame revenue in 24 hours (set by Grand Theft Auto V in 2013). Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".  "Sales revenue" refers to any officially announced U.S. dollar figure for revenue from sales of the game during the specified period, including retail sell-through, gross revenue, or net bookings. If multiple qualifying figures are announced, the highest will be used. Announcements that state only the number of units sold (e.g., "25 million copies sold") will not qualify. If such a figure is announced in a currency other than U.S. dollars, this market will resolve according to the converted value in U.S. dollars using the applicable conversion rate at the time of announcement.  This market will only consider sales revenue figures for the first 24 hours of wide release, beginning at the game's standard worldwide launch. Early-access periods for premium or special editions will not be considered part of the first 24 hours. A figure described as the game's "first day" or "launch day" sales revenue will be treated as a first 24 hour figure, regardless of staggered release times across time zones. Figures covering any other timeframe will not be considered.  Figures stated as a lower bound (e.g., "over $1 billion" or "more than $800 million") will qualify only if the stated bound exceeds $815.7 million. If no exact figure is available, figures stated as approximations (e.g., "about" or "around") will be taken at their stated value, while figures described as "nearly," "almost," or "just under" a value will be treated as just below that value.  Revenue from pre-orders recognized as part of launch sales and from all editions of the game, including premium and special editions, will count. Revenue from in-game purchases, including GTA Online currency, will not count.  This market will only consider officially announced first 24 hour sales revenue figures from a developer or distributor of GTA VI or an authorized representative thereof. Recognition of a new record by Guinness World Records is not required. If "Grand Theft Auto VI" is not released by January 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or if its first 24 hour sales revenue has not been announced by that time, this market will resolve to "No".  The primary resolution source for this market will be an official announcement from Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used. GTA 6 has ‘the strongest pre-order campaign on record’, is on track to sell 37-51 million in week one, analytics firm says
fuentes.texto: Grand Theft Auto 6’s pre-order campaign is the strongest on record so far, according to Newzoo . The video game market data, research and insights firm has released new analysis on the first week of pre-orders, based on digital spending data. According to its analysis, around $180 million was spent on digital pre-orders across the US and the five largest European markets during the last week of June. By using the player distribution of GTA 5 as a guide, Newzoo has estimated that the total global spend was around $260 million in the first week of pre-orders. “That kicks off the strongest pre-order campaign ever recorded,” the firm concluded. The company has also used this data to predict first week sales for Grand Theft Auto 6 when it’s released in November. According to Newzoo, hit titles usually follow three sales curves – the brand new IP (which has low pre-orders and takes off after reviews come in), the “sequel with performance uncertainty” (where players wait to see if a specific sequel is good before buying) and the “proven sequel” (where more pre-orders are booked early). The firm suggests GTA 6 will follow the proven sequel model, and predicts that the first-week pre-order sales account for roughly 5.8% of the total sales by the end of the game’s actual launch week. With that model in mind, Newzoo believes the game is on pace to reach $4.5 billion sales by the end of its first week on sale, meaning roughly 51 million copies sold. “A tremendous number by any historical standard” The company notes that because this GTA 6 is the most anticipated game of all time, its pre-orders could be more front-loaded than usual, but suggests that even if this is taken into account the game could still be looking at around $3.3 billion in sales by the end of its first week, or around 37 million units sold. “Contrary to social media reports, GTA 6 has not done a billion dollars in pre-orders 21 weeks out,” Newzoo’s analysis says. “This is absurd. Given how pre-order curves look, nothing ever has and nothing ever will in the near future. “What the data actually shows is $180 million in digital pre-order spend across the US and the five largest European markets in the final week of June, translating to a global opening week of roughly $260 million, with most of the ramp still ahead. “Run that figure through the plausible band of preorder curves, and GTA VI is on track to book between $3.25 billion and $5.2 billion in week-one launch revenue. Even at the most conservative reading, namely that GTA 6 front-loads harder than any major title in our dataset, it lands at a tremendous number by any historical standard.” 2 Comments Related VGC Content New GTA 6 trailer showcases PS5-exclusive DualSense features 5 hours ago Rockstar confirms GTA 6 targets 30 FPS, with PS5 Pro-exclusive ray-tracing 7 hours ago GTA 6 pre-orders are ‘far above initial expectations’ but NBA 2K27 was ‘below our forecast’, Take-Two says 11 hours ago Rockstar announces Grand Theft Auto 6 music festival taking place in Miami 1 day ago We sometimes publish affiliate links on VGC. fuentes.titulo: Take-Two stock rises on 'unprecedented' preorders for 'Grand Theft Auto VI'
fuentes.texto: Investors are revving their engines for the release of "Grand Theft Auto VI." Take-Two Interactive's ( TTWO ) stock was up more than 8% on Tuesday morning despite the video game studio's less-than-stellar Q2 earnings release. On Monday, the company reported revenue of $1.5 billion for the second quarter, down from $1.77 billion a year prior and missing analyst expectations of $1.65 billion, according to S&P Global Market Intelligence. But traders seem willing to hold tight until Nov. 19. Much of Take-Two's success for the year hinges on what happens over the next two weeks with the eagerly anticipated and much-delayed release of "Grand Theft Auto VI." On Monday, Take-Two said it expects fiscal year 2027 to be "historic." "Preorders for Grand Theft Auto VI are tracking far in excess of our initial expectations," CEO Strauss H. Zelnick said. "We know that the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough … with pre-orders continuing to reach unprecedented levels." Interestingly, that's also what the company said in August on its Q1 earnings call. While Q2 results showed net bookings down 18%, the company boosted its full-year revenue outlook to between $7.98 billion and $8.18 billion, driven by early success with GTA VI preorders. The launch of the game was punted twice, first to May 2026 and then to November. The previous iteration, "Grand Theft Auto V," was released in 2013, making this a very long-awaited sequel. For context, the time between GTA IV and V was just over five years. Following these delays, the stock has whipsawed over the past year, down more than 12% since January. The GTA franchise remains the central driver for Take-Two, with the video game studio leaning on the upcoming launch to offset the softer "NBA 2K27" contribution. "[GTA VI] promises to be not only highly engaging but in fact, the biggest and most detailed groundbreaking experience Rockstar Games has ever created," Zelnick said. GTA VI Pre-Orders Surpass $750 Million; Take-Two Reports Q2 Earnings Monday
fuentes.texto: Before a single copy of Grand Theft Auto VI reaches a PS5 or Xbox Series X, Rockstar's parent company has already collected an estimated $750 million in pre-order revenue. That figure — from Sensor Tower's November 3 tracking data — does not appear on Monday's balance sheet. It is a Q3 event. But it is the number that will hang over every analyst question on the 4:30 p.m. Eastern call, and it is the reason Take-Two Interactive's (NASDAQ: TTWO) second fiscal quarter results are, in one sense, almost beside the point. Monday's report — covering the three months ended September 30, 2026 — is not where the GTA VI story shows up financially. It is where management sets the table: confirming the November 19 date holds, issuing Q3 guidance that will formalize expectations for the launch quarter, and closing any remaining question about whether the company's pipeline is in shape to handle what may be the most commercially consequential product release in entertainment history. What the Q2 Numbers Actually Mean Take-Two guided Q2 net bookings of $1.62 billion to $1.67 billion, with GAAP revenue of $1.42 billion to $1.47 billion. Expect a GAAP net loss of $140 million to $157 million — a figure that reflects the company deliberately spending ahead of its November launch rather than any structural deterioration. The gap between net bookings and GAAP revenue (~$200 million) is intentional and routine. Net bookings, the non-GAAP metric Take-Two and its analysts treat as the primary measure, captures the total value of games and services sold in the quarter, including deferred revenue. For a company whose live-service titles — Grand Theft Auto Online, NBA 2K's MyTeam, mobile games through Zynga — generate recurring revenue across multiple quarters, the two figures rarely align. The more important number to watch: recurrent consumer spending (RCS), which has accounted for 82–84% of Take-Two's net bookings in recent quarters. For Q2, management guided RCS to decline roughly 5% year-over-year. That is a deliberately engineered trough — the company has been pulling back on certain Zynga mobile titles and conserving marketing spend to concentrate everything on GTA VI. A result that lands within that guidance range signals the transition is proceeding as planned. Consensus non-GAAP EPS sits around $0.97 for the quarter. For context: Q2 FY2026 non-GAAP EPS was $1.46, a comparison that reflects the deliberate spending posture rather than a business in trouble. The four-quarter streak: Take-Two has beaten its own bookings guidance in each of the past four quarters, with an average positive surprise of approximately 41.9% above consensus. That track record is part of why the options market is pricing ±10.2% earnings-day movement — above the company's 10-year average of 8.6% — with significant skew toward the upside. Something genuinely unexpected, in either direction, would need to happen for a 10%+ move on the Q2 numbers alone. The Only Number That Actually Matters Monday The Q3 FY2027 guidance. Street consensus currently sits at approximately $3.39 billion in net bookings for the launch quarter — more than double Q2's midpoint, and more than double anything Take-Two has ever posted in a single quarter. That figure is built on analyst models that assume GTA VI ships November 19, sells through its first week cleanly, and generates meaningful digital attach rates at $79.99 (or $99.99 for the Ultimate Edition). Wedbush projects $8.605 billion in annual net bookings for FY2027 — a figure that embeds about 40 million units of GTA VI over the full year. Morgan Stanley's model implies roughly 40 million units for FY2027 as well. Wolfe Research is more conservative, at 31 million to 35 million units, depending on pricing assumptions for digital versus physical sales. Sensor Tower's November 3 estimate of $750 million in gross pre-order revenue from digital platforms — with some tracking putting estimated pre-order unit counts at 25 million to 39 million copies — suggests the high end of those ranges may already be in reach on launch day alone, before the casual buyer enters the market. For comparison: GTA V sold 11.21 million copies in its first 24 hours in 2013. Newzoo's July first-week forecast put GTA VI's first-week revenue at $3.25 billion to $5.2 billion. Management's comments on Monday will clarify whether they intend to issue formal Q3 guidance at this point, narrow the existing FY2027 range of $8.0 billion to $8.2 billion, or hold those figures steady and let launch-week results speak in February. The GTA VI Launch in Context: What We Know The game is confirmed for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro, and Xbox Series X and S on November 19. PC is not part of the launch — multiple sources expect a 2027 PC release. Digital pre-loading begins November 12 , confirmed in Rockstar's June 25 pre-order announcement. A technical note that has not received wide coverage: Digital Foundry reported in June 2026 that GTA VI is unlikely to achieve 60 frames per second on PS5, PS5 Pro, or Xbox Series X at launch. This is relevant consumer context. The game is targeting 30fps with enhanced visual fidelity — a trade-off that Rockstar has not formally addressed, but that players on higher-end hardware should understand going in. One structural detail worth noting: physical copies of GTA VI contain a code-in-box, not a disc. There is no disc-based version of the game. This eliminates resale value for physical buyers and effectively mandates a digital installation, a decision that follows an industry direction set by several publishers over the past two years but marks Rockstar's first full commitment to the format for a mainline GTA title. The standard $79.99 price — confirmed June 25, 2026, alongside pre-orders — has been widely noted as a new tier above the $69.99 ceiling that defined the PS5 and Xbox Series generation since 2020. Worth a footnote for context: GTA V launched at $59.99 in 2013. In inflation-adjusted 2026 dollars, that is approximately $85 — meaning GTA VI's $79.99 is actually the cheapest major-platform GTA launch in inflation-adjusted terms in three console generations. Take-Two Interactive Chairman and CEO Strauss Zelnick has described the company's pricing philosophy at iicon : "Our job is to charge way, way, way less than the value we deliver." Whether $79.99 becomes the permanent new AAA floor across the industry — as $69.99 did when Sony and Microsoft normalized it in 2020 — is the structural question that makes this launch significant beyond its own sales figures. Pipeline Context: One Canceled Title At the August 7 Q1 FY2027 call , Take-Two disclosed the cancellation of one unnamed new-IP game. The company had previously spoken of three new IPs in development. That pipeline is now two. Zelnick did not name the canceled title or quantify the financial impact. It is worth asking on Monday's call whether a write-down related to the cancellation will affect Q2 results, and whether the pipeline reduction changes the company's FY2028 and beyond outlook. The NBA 2K franchise remains healthy: 2K26 sold 12 million-plus units as of the Q1 report, up 9% from NBA 2K25. Zynga's mobile portfolio is performing below the acquisition thesis, as the company has acknowledged in prior quarters, with management framing the mobile softness as a deliberate repositioning rather than fundamental weakness. Analyst Sentiment and What to Watch Wall Street's view on TTWO is notably bullish heading into Monday. The majority of analysts covering TTWO carry Buy ratings, with one or zero Sell ratings among the roughly 19–30 analysts tracked depending on the source. Price targets have been revised upward steadily since the November 2025 delay was absorbed. Shares fell approximately 6% in after-hours trading when the first delay (from fiscal 2026 to May 2026) was announced in November 2025, and fell again when the second delay to November 2026 was confirmed. Both drops have since been recovered. Options markets are pricing ±10.2% earnings-day movement, above the 10-year average of 8.6%. The asymmetry of the bet is notable: downside risk centers on a third delay announcement (essentially unthinkable at this point, ten days from launch), while upside potential is tied to guidance that formally validates the $8+ billion FY2027 consensus. Key questions to monitor on the call: Does management issue formal Q3 net bookings guidance, and does it confirm or narrow the $8.0–8.2B FY2027 range? Does Zelnick quantify any pre-order metric — units, revenue, digital-versus-physical split — or maintain information discipline into launch week? Is there any update on the GTA Online transition — specifically, whether GTA VI's online mode launches alongside the game or follows later? Does management comment on the canceled new-IP title and any associated Q2 write-down? Is there any announcement on the PC release timeline? fuentes.titulo: Grand Theft Auto 6 pre-orders are tracking far above expectations according to Take-Two (TTWO)
fuentes.texto: Take-Two Interactive has updated its fiscal year guidance based on pre-orders for GTA 6's standard and Ultimate Edition packages. Ozzie Mejia November 9, 2026 1:38 PM Rockstar Games 1 Take-Two Interactive (TTWO) issued its Q2 FY27 earnings report and, as expected, there were several mentions of Grand Theft Auto 6. According to Take-Two, GTA6 pre-orders are tracking far above the publisher's initial expectations. That reinforces the company's fiscal year guidance, where it currently has an outlook range of $8 to $8.2 billion USD. "Pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto 6 are tracking far above our initial expectations, and we know that the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough," reads the fiscal year guidance on the Take-Two Q2 2027 earnings presentation . Take-Two anticipates a $3.35 to $3.5 billion net bookings figure. Furthermore, the company is expecting a 12 percent increase of recurrent consumer spending (RCS) based on "significant growth" for the GTA series, led by sales of the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition. In case of a tie for the winner, this market will resolve in favor of the nominated game whose listed title comes first in alphabetical order.  If, for any reason, no winner is declared by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".  The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from The Game Awards, including data from their website (e.g., https://thegameawards.com/) and the live broadcast of the award ceremony; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
